scenicChapters.narrative: For 35 km this is Irohazaka · Nikkō, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Irohazaka · Nikkō
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 7 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

japan-irohazaka-roads.story: 44 km from Imaichi to Nikkō, about 45 min of riding. On the way it passes Irohazaka hairpins and Akechidaira. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Bromo Tengger Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 28 km this is Bromo Tengger Scenic Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Bromo Tengger Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2400 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

bromo-tengger-scenic-road.story: A 100 km one-way ride from near Malang, about 1 h 42 of riding. On the way it passes Tumpang, Jemplang and Mount Bromo. The highest point is about 2,400 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
